_comment: Pinned third-party harness versions the throne vendors into ./vendor/.
install.sh reads this file; nothing resolves 'latest' at install time, so
two machines cloning the same commit get byte-identical harnesses.
which also carries its per-artifact sha256 checksums.
tools.ntfy pins the ntfy server image. ntfy runs as a container on every
throne host (docker or podman, whichever is present); install.sh pulls
this tag and systemd/ntfy-serve runs it.
tools.conduwuit pins the conduwuit (continuwuity) Matrix homeserver
image, run the same way by systemd/conduwuit-serve.
tools.forgejo pins the Forgejo forge image (the -rootless variant, which
runs as an unprivileged user). Only install-forgejo.sh pulls it, and
systemd/forgejo-serve runs it, on the tailnet address only.
tools.tea pins the tea CLI release install-forgejo.sh installs, with the
sha256 of each platform's binary from the release's checksums.txt;
agent_docs/forgejo.md records where each sha256 came from.
To move a pin: edit the version here, run ./install.sh, verify, commit.
